newsitem.title: USA: Tuscarora sees Q4 in line with last Q4.
newsitem.headline: Tuscarora sees Q4 in line with last Q4.

text.p: Tuscarora Inc said Tuesday that it is "cautiously optimistic" that results for the fourth quarter will approximate the results for the same period last year.
Tuscarora reported third quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, compared to $0.25 a share the previous third quarter. Last year, it earned $0.34 a share in the fourth quarter.
The company said that shipping rates improved toward the end of the third quarter, and that the operating problems at two facilities have been substantially corrected.
As previously indicated, the third quarter earnings were hurt by two large customers adjusting inventory levels and reducing their packaging requirements.
The company also cited overhead costs associated with acquisitions made in the first quarter and operating problems at two of the company's 29 U.S. manufacturing facilities.
